requirements.quote: The MANUFACTURER shall provide a NEMA four-hole pad and insulating boots for incoming and outgoing cable connection of up to two (2) 750 MCM 15kV cables, per phase.
requirements.text: Provide a NEMA four-hole pad and insulating boots for cable connections.

requirements.quote: Furnish two (2) bus Sections with tie breaker to contain the equipment specified in Contract Documents.
requirements.text: Provide two bus sections with a tie breaker.

requirements.quote: The Circuit Breaker shall be designed, rated, tested, and manufactured in accordance with codes and standards stated herein, except that in event of contradictory requirements between IEEE, ANSI, or NEMA and this Specification.
requirements.text: Design and manufacture the circuit breaker per specified standards.

requirements.quote: Furnish relays, controls and associated accessories and hardware as required for a complete functional and operational system. AC/DC power supply will be provided by others.
requirements.text: Provide relays, controls, and accessories for a functional system.
